hypothesis: When all 2187 three-colour nearest-neighbour totalistic cellular automata are run from a single gray cell for a few thousand steps, about 85 % produce patterns whose late-time central region is time-periodic or compresses like classical nested patterns, and the remaining 15 % or so compress like random or class-4 (localised-structure) patterns.
pass_criterion: Pre-registered. Each code c in 0..2186 (Wolfram's convention: base-3 digit k of c is the new colour for neighbourhood sum k in 0..6; colours 0 = white, 1 = gray, 2 = black) is run for T = 3000 steps from a single gray cell on a white background with an array wide enough that boundary effects cannot reach the central 128 columns. Statistics on the central strip (columns -64..63): (i) periodic: rows 2250..2999 are time-periodic with some period p <= 256; (ii) rho = 8 * lzma_bytes / (cells * log2(3)) over rows 1500..2999. Calibration (performed before the codes are run): nested references are the same-size strips of Pascal's triangle mod 3 (3 symbols), Pascal's triangle mod 2, and the Thue-Morse and period-doubling outer-product patterns (normalised by log2 of their own alphabet size); irregular references are the strips of elementary rules 110, 124, 137, 193 (localised structures) and 30, 45 (random) run from a single black cell with the same geometry. tau = geometric mean of the largest nested-reference rho and the smallest irregular-reference rho. A code is 'regular' iff it is periodic or rho < tau. 'supports' if the regular fraction lies in [0.80, 0.90].
fail_criterion: Pre-registered. 'refutes' if the regular fraction is below 0.70 or above 0.95. 'mixed' if it lies in [0.70, 0.80) or (0.90, 0.95]. 'inconclusive' with reason 'other' if the calibration fails to separate the reference classes (largest nested rho >= smallest irregular rho). The number of irregular codes that are random-looking (rho above the smallest random reference) versus structured-irregular is reported but not decisive.
interpretation: 'Ultimately quite regular' is read as 'repetitive or nested at late times', operationalised as late-time periodicity of the central strip or compressibility at the level of classical nested patterns; 'the remainder' as everything compressing like random or localised-structure patterns, with elementary class-3 and class-4 rules from a different family used to fix the threshold. 'About 85 %' is given a +/- 5 percentage-point band. Long transients (Wolfram mentions code 1599 resolving only after thousands of steps) may leave a few ultimately regular codes labelled irregular at T = 3000, which biases the regular fraction downward slightly. All patterns are generated by analysis.py; there is no external download.

datasets.name: All 2187 three-colour nearest-neighbour totalistic cellular automata (Wolfram code numbering) from a single gray cell, 3000 steps, generated by analysis.py, plus the calibration reference patterns described in pass_criterion
datasets.role: the finite rule space whose regular fraction the claim reports
